abilityInfo.Earth Eater: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.
abilityInfo.Purifying Salt: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.
abilityInfo.Toxic Debris: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.
abilityInfo.Good as Gold: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
abilityInfo.Supreme Overlord: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.
abilityInfo.Hospitality: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.
abilityInfo.Heatproof: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.
abilityInfo.Supersweet Syrup: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
abilityInfo.Sticky Hold: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.
